Name: HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][img]https://i.imgur.com/buIbPlm.png[/img]


[size=3]If you're reading this and have had any experience with HxW mods, you know Hime and I are constantly scope creeping ourselves with new ideas for mods. While finishing up our Sunberry NPCs, Hime came up with a TON of new building concepts for us to work on, and by doing so...it meant the older buildings might need a little refresh. That's where this mod comes in!

This mod will auto-detect whichever version of our building mods you are using (either the individual bakery/tea shop mods or the all in one pack) and will edit the bakery and tea shop buildings to these new and improved exteriors.

These are actually a few tiles bigger than the originals, hence why we couldn't just put them in as new skins.

This mod also comes with [b]10 (11 total!) additional color schemes[/b] for these buildings! These color schemes will be added to other buildings in the future and I will be working on recolors for the winery shortly. You can access these color options either directly from the build menu at Robin's or via Alternative Textures once the building is already on your farm.
[/size][size=4]
[b]WAIT THERE'S MORE.[/b][/size][size=3]

This also includes [b][i]automatic[/i] foliage recolor support[/b] for Earthy Recolor, Vibrant Pastoral Recolor, and Starblue Valley Recolor.[/size][size=3]

Pretty cool, huh?[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TIAbpPO.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3t3uNyH.png[/img]
[size=3]Hey there! Just want to make sure it's super clear that you don't need BOTH the individual bakery/tea shop mods and the all in one mod; this mod will auto detect whichever ones you are using and adjust for that!

You just need ANY of the HxW mods listed above for it to work; if you don't have them, then there is nothing for this mod to do.

Alternative Textures is not required BUT you can use it to access the different building colors if desired.
[/size][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/rSzqpms.png[/img]
[quote][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b][i]HELP! The mod isn’t working! What do I do?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/quote][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Ensure your mods are up to date. Not just my mods - all of your mods. If I get a log with out of date mods I will not help you.[/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3]Double check you have all the required mods installed for THIS mod to run.[/size]
[*][size=3]Delete the old version of the mod and go download a fresh version and install. Do NOT overwrite.[/size]
[*][size=3]Still not working? Go to [b][color=#d9ead3]log.smapi.io[/color][/b] and follow the instructions there to get your game log.[/size]
[*][size=3]Please look at your log first before submitting a bug report, as it can often tell you how to solve the problem.[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][size=3]Submit log via the [b]bug reports tab[/b] with a detailed description of your issue and a copy of your cauldron config.[/size][/size][/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]Do [b]NOT[/b] copy and paste the raw data text. Do [b]NOT[/b] submit a bug report without a SMAPI log. If a bug report is already present for your bug, do [b]NOT[/b] duplicate it with another report. Doing any of these things will result in the removal of said bug report. Continued ignoring of these guidelines will result in me blocking you from commenting on my mods.[/size][size=3][size=3]
[size=3]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2bSyOpH.png[/img]
